name: Glean
desc: Permission-aware enterprise search and work AI agents over company data.
desc_zh: 在企业数据上做权限感知的搜索与工作 AI 智能体。
solves: The answer is somewhere in the company, but you cannot find it — and may not be allowed to. It searches only what you can already see.
solves_zh: 答案就在公司某个地方，但你找不到——甚至可能根本没权限看。它只搜索你本来就有权查看的内容。
best_for: When a question spans the tools your team uses and permissions must be respected.
best_for_zh: 问题横跨团队用的多个工具、同时又必须遵守权限的时候。
notes: Shows that enterprise AI value comes from company context, not a bigger model. 来源：https://www.glean.com/about/glean-story
